interpretation.plain_speak: The response survived a much harder layout shift. Ninety-six original dependencies would have failed; the guided rule saved all ninety-six. Moving the wrong dependency at the same action count saved none.
interpretation.north_star_question: Moves the bounded corrective mechanism from a single schedule result toward a general rule, while exposing intervention budget as the next practical constraint.
interpretation.next_stage: freeze per-arm action budgets and measure how prevention degrades when Wingless cannot close every endangered dependency, comparing warning-guided prioritization with budget-matched sham
